changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetTag') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetTag_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NULL, [TagID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetTag] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [UC_AssetTag_AssetID_TagID] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [AssetID] ASC, [TagID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET] FOREIGN KEY([AssetID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Asset] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_ASSET] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_ASSETTAG_TAG') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_TAG] FOREIGN KEY([TagID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Tag] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AssetTag] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ASSETTAG_TAG] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetTag_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetTag_AssetID] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] ( [AssetID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetTag_TagID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetTag_TagID] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] ( [TagID] ASC ) END

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] AFTER DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) SELECT 'ObjectIndex', 'U', A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.ID FROM deleted D INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] A ON D.AssetID = A.ID;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetTag_AfterUpsert] ON [dbo].[AssetTag] AFTER INSERT, UPDATE AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID],[AssetID]) SELECT 'ObjectIndex', 'U', A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.ID FROM inserted I INNER JOIN [dbo].[Asset] A ON I.AssetID = A.ID;
